record.title: Erdős–Kac divisor-function series conjecture

\]
Is $\alpha_k$ irrational for every $k\ge 1$?

record.title: Gasca–Maeztu conjecture for planar GC sets
record.statement: The Gasca–Maeztu conjecture asserts that every planar $GC_n$ set has a maximal line. record.title: Undecidability of nonnegativity for trace polynomials on real symmetric matrices
record.statement: **Instance:** A positive integer $k$ and a trace polynomial $f(X_1,\ldots,X_k)$. **Question:** Is $f(M_1,\ldots,M_k)$ nonnegative for all real symmetric matrices $M_1,\ldots,M_k$ of all sizes (for all $1\le i\le k$)? The report states that this decision problem is undecidable.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2023/15](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/12697711), page 25. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Bobadilla–Kollár conjecture on smoothness from locally constant integral cohomology
record.statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a proper morphism between complex manifolds. Then $f$ is smooth if and only if $R^i f_*\mathbb{Z}$ is a local system for all $i$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2023/18](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/13750327), page 31. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Local–Global Conjecture for Integral Circle Packings
record.statement: Given an integral packing $P$ and a choice of coordinates $\iota$, let $B=B(P,\iota)$ be its set of bends. The report states the conjecture that there exists $q_0$ such that, for all sufficiently large $n$ (in terms of $P$ and $\iota$), $$n\in B\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad n\in B\pmod{q_0}.$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2023/22](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/13750333), page 37. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Beilinson Conjecture for smooth projective varieties over finite fields
record.statement:
Let $F$ be a finite field, let $\ell$ be a prime invertible in $F$, and let $X$ be a smooth projective variety over $F$. For every codimension $i$, the cycle class map
$$
\operatorname{cl}_X^i:\operatorname{CH}^i(X)_{\mathbb{Q}_\ell}\longrightarrow H^{2i}(\overline{X},\mathbb{Q}_\ell(i))
$$
is injective.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2023/27](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/13750339), page 9. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Conjecture 4: Vanishing conjecture for projective space in even degree
record.statement:
For any finite field $F$ of characteristic $p$ and any prime $\$ invertible in $F$, one has
\[
H^{2i}\!\left(F_0\mathbb{P}^n_{\overline F},\mathbb{Q}_{\u001b}(i+1)\right)^{G_F}=0
\]
for all integers $i,n\ge 2$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2023/27](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/13750339), page 11. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.
